title: Near the Cross
alsoKnownAs: Jesus, Keep Me Near the Cross
description: Near the Cross in Tonic Solfa to NEAR THE CROSS: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Fanny Crosby wrote the words, first published in 1869. The tune, NEAR THE CROSS, is by William H. Doane (1869).
underlay: Je-sus, keep me near the cross, There a pre-cious foun-tain— Free to all, a heal-ing stream— Flows from Cal-v’ry’s moun-tain. In the cross, in the cross, Be my glo-ry ev-er; Till my rap-tured soul shall find Rest be-yond the riv-er.

lines: Jesus, keep me near the cross,
There a precious fountain—
Free to all, a healing stream—
Flows from Calv’ry’s mountain.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: In the cross, in the cross,
Be my glory ever;
Till my raptured soul shall find
Rest beyond the river.
Near the cross, a trembling soul,
Love and Mercy found me;
There the bright and morning star
Sheds its beams around me.
Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Bring its scenes before me;
Help me walk from day to day,
With its shadows o’er me.
Near the cross I’ll watch and wait
Hoping, trusting ever,
Till I reach the golden strand,
Just beyond the river.
